Then timeskip AGAIN: I was in the opposite end of the class, no one next to me, and some girl comes to me crying saying that she needed to fix all these wires coming from her keyboard. So I got sticky tape to stick it from my mom somehow when we are still in school. Then I stuck it, and it still somewhat worked, and then I woke. I almost forgot this dream today.
